record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The five units in appliesTo declare FOUL_PLAY in this production reference. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (table index), maxPP, passive and stats. Passives BAD_LUCK (Murkrow, Honchkrow) and HATCH (Sandile, Krokorok) are not investigated.
record.summary: Deals one hit of special damage to the cast target whose raw amount is a star-indexed multiplier (2/4/6/12) times the TARGET's current atk (not the caster's). No movement, no status, no buff.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to process (the unit's current attack target); no retargeting or area
targeting.note: Target selection before the cast and range handling were not read; with range 1 the caster is adjacent to its target in normal play (not verified).

geometry.shape: single target; no area, no movement

effects.scaling: raw = multiplier x target.atk read at cast time; then AP: damage x (1 + caster AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); the cast crit flag multiplies by critPower only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: then the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, min 1) and later untraced modifiers; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star column (12) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts of the five units (1,2,2,3,1). Whether other mechanics raise a star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None in the strategy; it only needs a target.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state and no modes: each cast reads the target's current atk and deals one hit.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: multiplier 2/4/6 (1-3 stars) x the target's atk. Damage dealt is raw x (1 + AP/100), then SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and untraced modifiers. The multiplier alone is not a damage amount.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers) - only the SPECIAL speDef division and the minimum of 1 were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the base process was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
Whether target.atk includes buffs, debuffs or item effects at cast time (atk is a plain field read here; how it is modified elsewhere was not examined)
unresolved: Passives BAD_LUCK and HATCH were not investigated: whether they change the cast or the stats is unknown
Whether any item or synergy effect changes FOUL_PLAY damage beyond the generic path read
Target selection before the cast and whether the target can be an ally or an untargettable unit were not read
Krookodile declares no passive in its class block (declaredPassive NONE as in the catalog convention)
